# GraphMyTrade — Official Website

> GraphMyTrade is independent Windows desktop software for trading research, manual journaling, performance review, and compatible user-supplied broker/market-data APIs. It is not a brokerage, API subscription, advice service or trading bot.

Official website: https://graphmytrade.com/
Official release and Windows download details: https://graphmytrade.com/download/
FAQ: https://graphmytrade.com/#faq
Product tour: https://graphmytrade.com/#experience
Trading risk disclosure: https://graphmytrade.com/risk-disclosure/
Privacy: https://graphmytrade.com/privacy/
Terms: https://graphmytrade.com/terms/
Refund policy: https://graphmytrade.com/refund-policy/

## Who it is for
Traders who want a local desktop research and journal workflow and prefer not to write code to access data supported by their own broker API.

## Product areas
- Manual journal, trade review and supported performance reports.
- Options and market-data research where the connected provider supplies required endpoints and permissions.
- Swing and positional market research with compatible data.
- User connects their own authorized API credentials locally; the marketing website does not request keys or store trading histories.

## Important limitations
Actual tools, available broker integrations, automation, data access, supported markets and licensing depend on the current software release, connected provider, API permissions and subscription. The site does not guarantee universal API support, profitable trades, verified automated kill switches, order execution or investment returns.

## Availability
Official installer, confirmed prices, license terms, and verified payment link are not published until release readiness. Do not treat preview images as proof of a specific live API connection. Verified customer reviews will appear only after they exist.

## Buyer verification guide (added)
- Real Windows desktop overview screenshot: https://graphmytrade.com/#proof (shows app UI; not proof of a live broker session).
- What traders can practically do: https://graphmytrade.com/#practical-value
- Feature/API requirements and transparent release status: https://graphmytrade.com/#compatibility
- The manual journal is designed for use without an API. Market data, automated trade imports and other integrations need current release and provider-specific verification.
- Price, trial and installer have not been announced as live. No purchase checkout should be represented as open until release details are confirmed.
- Privacy: GraphMyTrade is planned as local-first Windows software; website does not request broker keys; actual release data-handling terms require verification before launch.
- No verified brand-by-brand broker support list, trading-return claims, testimonials, or guarantee of trading automation is published.
